svg.text: four shared input rows x0..x3 · four independent output columns · cell = differential G+/G− pair · Vout_j = Rf·Gscale·(W@u)_j
each cell realizes w_ij·Gscale = G+_ij − G−_ij (balanced zero at G0); every column is an independent 0007 column sharing the input rails
each TIA stage is an independent linear network solved in its own netlist and combined by superposition (8 stages, one per half-column)
columns are uncoupled: changing column j's weights never changes any Vout_j′ for j′ ≠ j (verified: 0.0e+00 V in the 0013 extract)
Vout_j = Vm_j − Vp_j = Rf·Σ_i u_i·(G+_ij − G−_ij) = Rf·Gscale·(W@u)_j
